title: Just two of my nuts a day is all you need 🥜
caption:
More than that and you're in trouble 😅
Tag the one who eats the whole bag 👇
sources: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements, 'Selenium: Fact Sheet for Health Professionals' (Brazil nuts 68-91 mcg per nut; adult RDA 55 mcg; upper limit 400 mcg; selenosis signs: garlic breath, hair and nail loss or brittleness)
